purpose: Static malicious-behavior review only; publication is separately verified and is not review evidence.

scope.build: golang:1.26-alpine; go mod download; CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux go build ./cmd/server; binary --help in approved publication only
scope.runtime: alpine:3.22.0; tzdata ca-certificates; /app/CLIProxyAPIPlus; config.example.yaml; port 8317; existing configured provider/Home/plugin/management behavior
scope.scope: All changed files complete diff; changed dependencies provenance/install behavior; necessary sensitive context; reuse unchanged approved baseline; no recursive unexecuted developer/CI/toolchain certification

documentation_configuration.purpose: Provider description and Ebb catalog links are documentation only; compression example changes comments only. No executable/download/install behavior added.

compression.purpose: Response gzip/zstd encoders are reset to the current response writer, returned to existing pools, and detached to io.Discard. Decode changes defer sniffing to Read and use synchronous zstd decoding. No new endpoint, credential access or executable interpretation. New benchmarks/tests use generated data, pipes and local recorders.

model_registry_and_baseline_tests.purpose: Web-search indexes count registered in-memory model capabilities and retract contributions on registration changes. Other model/discovery/no-copy/auth tests adjust fixture expectations and platform handling. No new production source, download, process execution or persistent access path. Discovery test adds an error-specific skip; assertions and correctness are outside this malicious-behavior review.

websocket_session_and_interrupt.purpose: Tracks active/terminal response identity on the existing socket and separates WebSocket-owned turns from local HTTP cancellation. Necessary shared context confirms existing session lookup, enabled-auth callback, existing socket write, rejection and diagnostic hashing. New tests use httptest endpoints and synthetic credentials; no arbitrary execution or external exfiltration path added.

sse_and_image_framing.purpose: Reassembles fragments and synthetic line breaks as JSON/SSE data and filters response.metadata for non-Codex clients; preserves existing writer and error-event handling. No evaluation of payload text or alternate network destination. Complete framing/metadata tests statically read only.

dependencies.method: Full tree comparison shows no dependency manifest/lock/build-script changes; reuse approved v8.0.45 unchanged baseline. All changed imports read; additions use stdlib or existing local/dependency modules. No new install script.
dependencies.boundary: No recursive certification of unexecuted upstream developer/CI/toolchains.

limits: Scoped conclusion only: not a bug, vulnerability, correctness, quality, performance or test-assertion review. No scanners, tests or upstream execution during review.
Unchanged approved dependencies/build/runtime reused. External services, future remote content and separately configured plugins are not newly certified.
Approved publication CI builds are permitted only after this decision; no deployment/restart.
